Accessed September 4, 2014. |website = {{URL|https://www.elizabethnj.org/}} }} [[File:Régis François Gignoux, View Near Elizabethtown, N. J., 1847.jpg|thumb|''View Near Elizabethtown, N. J.'', oil painting by [[Régis François Gignoux]], [[Honolulu Museum of Art]]]] '''Elizabeth''' is a [[City (New Jersey)|city]] in and the [[county seat]] of [[Union County, New Jersey|Union County]], in the [[U.S. state]] of [[New Jersey]].[https://www.nj.gov/state/archives/catctytable.html New Jersey County Map] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170313034019/http://www.nj.gov/state/archives/catctytable.html |date=March 13, 2017 }}, [[New Jersey Department of State]]. Accessed December 1, 2022. As of the [[2020 United States census]], the city retained its ranking as [[List of municipalities in New Jersey|the state's fourth-most-populous city]] behind neighboring [[Newark, New Jersey|Newark]], [[Jersey City, New Jersey|Jersey City]] and [[Paterson, New Jersey|Paterson]],[https://nj.gov/labor/lpa/census/2020/2020%20pl94%20Tables/2020_PL94_Summary/Table_1_2020.xlsx Table 1. New Jersey Counties and Most Populous Cities and Townships: 2020 and 2010 Censuses] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220328223109/https://nj.gov/labor/lpa/census/2020/2020%20pl94%20Tables/2020_PL94_Summary/Table_1_2020.xlsx |date=March 28, 2022 }}, [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]]. Accessed March 19, 2022.[http://lwd.dol.state.nj.us/labor/lpa/census/2010/2010data/nj_tab1.xls The Counties and Most Populous Cities and Townships in 2010 in New Jersey: 2000 and 2010], [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]]. Accessed November 21, 2016. with a population of 137,298, an increase of 12,329 (+9.9%) from the [[2010 United States census|2010 census]] count of 124,969, which in turn reflected an increase of 4,401 (3.7%) from the 120,568 counted in the [[2000 United States census|2000 census]].[https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls Table 7. Population for the Counties and Municipalities in New Jersey: 1990, 2000 and 2010] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220602092646/https://www.nj.gov/labor/labormarketinformation/assets/PDFs/census/2010/2010data/table7cm.xls |date=June 2, 2022 }}, [[New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development]], February 2011. Accessed May 1, 2023. The [[Population Estimates Program]] calculated a population of 141,675 for 2025, making it the [[List of United States cities by population|199th-most populous city]] in the nation[https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/tables/2020-2025/cities/totals/SUB-IP-EST2025-ANNRNK.xlsx Annual Estimates of the Resident Population for Incorporated Places of 20,000 or More, Ranked by July 1, 2025 Population: April 1, 2020 to July 1, 2025], [[United States Census Bureau]], released May 2026. Accessed June 1, 2026. and the fifth-most populous municipality of any type in the state, falling behind [[Lakewood Township, New Jersey|Lakewood Township]].{{efn|Note that the Census Bureau excludes townships from its rankings of municipalities by population.}}
